policy.source_of_truth: This file is the version-controlled portfolio seed. It does not automatically publish products to the user-facing catalog.
policy.decision_status: confirmed means the product direction or module has been explicitly established in prior planning; candidate means the idea or grouping remains a proposal requiring validation.
policy.lifecycle_status: Lifecycle describes delivery maturity, not whether a product is enabled for public activation.
policy.activation: A portfolio entry only links to an activatable Product record when an administrator explicitly configures activation_product_key.
